'''Kiara''' is an [[NPC]] found in the {{zone|North Reaches}}. They teach the player about Reptile and Amphibian [[Shards]]. They also sell {{Item|Viper Shard}}s, {{Item|Crocodile Shard}}s, {{Item|Eel Shard}}s, and {{Item|Gecko Shard}}s.

== UI ==
{{/UI}}

== Abiphone Contact ==
'''Kiara's''' [[Abiphone]] contact can be obtained by giving them a {{Item|Chameleon Shard}}. Obtaining their contact increases the daily stock of their shop by {{Green|+1}}.
